source.label: Bob's Guide to Classic Pinball Machines

strategy.summary: Collect 1-5. Complete the white and green banks. Then repeat the lit left orbit.

steps.text: Plunge for a missing 1-4 top lane. Collect 5 at the right standup target.
modeNotes: Number: Each collected number lights one white drop target and one star rollover in the left orbit.

steps.text: Use the left orbit to return to the top until at least three numbers are collected.
Hit the lit white drop targets. Each hit advances the end-of-ball bonus faster.
Complete all five white drop targets to light 2x bonus.
modeNotes: Bonus: Drop targets build a maximum 19,000 base bonus. The 2x award raises the maximum payout to 38,000.

steps.text: Complete the four green drop targets. Each target adds 1,000 to the upper-right saucer, up to 5,000.
After 1-5 is complete, repeat the left orbit. Its five star rollovers score 1,000 each, and the orbit scores 5,000.
Use the top lanes and bumpers after each orbit. Then shoot the orbit again from the right flipper.

fallback.title: Bonus only
fallback.when: Use this plan when the left-orbit return is unsafe.

steps.text: Collect numbers 1-4 through the top lanes. Collect number 5 at its standup target only when its rebound is controlled.
Hit the matching lit white targets.
Complete the white bank for 2x bonus.
Stop forcing the orbit. Protect the 38,000 maximum bonus payout.

alternatives.title: Green bank and saucer
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the center-bank rebounds and the saucer feed are predictable.

modeNotes: Saucer: Its value starts at 1,000. Each green target adds 1,000, and the 5,000 value stays lit after the bank is complete.

steps.text: Return to the bonus or left-orbit plan after the kickout.
Build the base bonus to 19,000 with drop targets.
Complete the white bank for 2x bonus.
Complete 1-5 to light all five left-orbit stars.
Repeat the 5,000 orbit and its five 1,000-point star rollovers.

techniques.name: Left-orbit repeat
techniques.instruction: Shoot the left orbit from the right flipper. Use its top-lane return to collect numbers, then repeat after 1-5 is complete.

techniques.name: Missing-number plunge
techniques.instruction: Change plunge strength to reach a missing 1-4 lane. Avoid a plunge that falls back down the left orbit.

cautions.issue: A ball that rolls from the center wedge behind the green bank can enter the right outlane or rebound to the center drain.
cautions.response: Test this feed before you repeat the center bank. Use the left-orbit route when the wedge feed is not controllable.

cautions.issue: The angled drop-target banks can send a hard rebound toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Stop direct bank shots when this copy produces repeated center rebounds; use the orbit and bonus route instead.

cautions.issue: Rapid switch hits can finish before the EM score motor records the second score or bonus advance.
cautions.response: Check the bonus lamp after a fast combination. Do not plan the next shot from an unconfirmed advance.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Build the base bonus to 19,000 with drop targets.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Bonus only: Use this plan when the left-orbit return is unsafe.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Gottlieb Vulcan, ball count, target resets, and award conversions.
Test the orbit, white and green banks, saucer, and upper feeds.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Vulcan, collect numbers 1 through 4 in the top lanes and number 5 at the right standup. Each number lights one white drop target; complete all five white drops to light 2x Bonus. Once all five numbers are lit, repeat the left orbit for its five star rollovers and 5,000-point orbit award.
strategy.overview: In Vulcan, the left orbit returns the ball to the numbered top lanes, and collected numbers light the matching white drops and left-orbit stars. Use that orbit to finish 1 through 5, complete the white bank for 2x Bonus, then repeat the fully lit orbit. Complete the green bank and collect the upper-right saucer only when its kickout is controlled.
